D001916.s: The continuation of the axillary artery; it branches into the radial and ulnar arteries.

D002283.s: Malignant neoplasm arising from the epithelium of the bronchi. It represents a large group of epithelial lung malignancies which can be divided into two clinical groups: small cell lung cancer and NON-small-cell lung carcinoma.

D002430.s: Tumors or cancer of the cecum.

D003077.s: A residue of coal, left after dry (destructive) distillation, used as a fuel.

D003099.s: Test designed to identify students suitable for admission into a graduate or undergraduate curriculum.

D003727.s: Personnel whose work is prescribed and supervised by the dentist and who provide dental related care.

D006298.s: The organization and administration of health services dedicated to the delivery of health care.

D007349.s: Payment by a third-party payer in a sum equal to the amount expended by a health care provider or facility for health services rendered to an insured or program beneficiary. (From Facts on File Dictionary of Health Care Management, 1988)

D007419.s: Fluids originating from the epithelial lining of the intestines, adjoining exocrine glands and from organs such as the liver, which empty into the cavity of the intestines.

D007576.s: Absence of teeth from a portion of the mandible and/or maxilla.

D008487.s: Acquiring information from a patient on past medical conditions and treatments.

This elevates the left atrial pressure which, in turn, raises pulmonary venous and capillary pressure leading to bouts of dyspnea and tachycardia during physical exertion.

These inorganic, organic, particulate, or vaporized matters usually are inhaled by workers in their occupational environment, leading to the various forms (asbestosis; byssinosis; and others).

D011485.s: The process in which substances, either endogenous or exogenous, bind to proteins, peptides, enzymes, protein precursors, or allied compounds. Specific protein-binding measures are often used as assays in diagnostic assessments.

D012949.s: Use of all social work processes in the treatment of patients in a psychiatric or mental health setting.

D013168.s: Forward displacement of a superior vertebral body over the vertebral body below.

D013270.s: An organ of digestion situated in the left upper quadrant of the abdomen between the termination of the esophagus and the beginning of the duodenum.

D016321.s: The giving of attention to the special dental needs of the elderly for proper maintenance or treatment. The dental care may include the services provided by dental specialists.

D018420.s: Diseases of chimpanzees, gorillas, and orangutans.

D033261.s: The bond or lack thereof between a pregnant person and their fetus.

D052246.s: A subclass of cyclooxygenase inhibitors with specificity for cyclooxygenase-2.

D053263.s: Interacting DNA-encoded regulatory subsystems in the genome that coordinate input from activator and repressor transcription factors during development, cell differentiation, or in response to environmental cues.

D055548.s: The contribution to barometric pressure of gaseous substance in equilibrium with its solid or liquid phase.

D000099061.s: A combination of defects comprising omphalocele, exstrophy of the cloaca, anus imperforate, and spinal defects.
